values.note: DNR says the campsites are 'open seasonally' and gives no dates.

note: WV DNR campground in the 14,000-acre Lewis Wetzel Wildlife Management Area south of New Martinsville, near Jacksonburg (Wetzel County). First come first served. Trailheads for loop hikes leave from the campground. --Claude
summary: WV DNR's District 1 list and its Lewis Wetzel WMA page confirm a primitive campground with 20 tent/trailer sites, open seasonally (no dates), vault toilets: sites and vault toilets move to manual, season recorded as not year-round. DNR silent on fees, reservations/FCFS and drinking water (booking, potable_water, electric left derived). Phone 304-825-6787 is the DNR District 1 office (correct). Note trimmed of count/season/toilet/water restatements; acreage corrected 13,000 -> 14,000 (DNR: 14,072 / 14,081 acres).
flags: No DNR page states a fee or that the campground is free; fees stay unknown.
